mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months indicates labor market deterioration, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) signals broad consumer demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth is threatened.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply chain disruption regime, a sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates reduced manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and growth concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 5% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in inflation exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months (CPIAUCSL) prompts expectations of tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over three months indicates a strong labor market, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate (FEDFUNDS and UNRATE) signals a tightening monetary cycle that is harming the labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a deceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates slowing economic momentum, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in an upcoming slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth decelerates (year-over-year growth falls by more than 0.5pp) in the current quarter.
